ADSP Phenotype Harmonization Consortium (PHC) - Composite Biomarker Plasma Scores

Source: R/data.R
ADSP_PHC_PLASMA.Rd

ADSP Phenotype Harmonization Consortium (PHC) - Composite Biomarker Plasma Scores data. More information is available at https://adni.loni.usc.edu/data-samples/adni-data/

Usage

data(ADSP_PHC_PLASMA)

Format

A data frame with 1720 observations and 23 variables.

Source

https://adni.loni.usc.edu/data-samples/adni-data/

Details

  • ORIGPROT character Original study protocol , with options: ADNI1, ADNIGO, ADNI2, ADNI3, ADNI4

  • COLPROT character Study protocol of data collection , with options: ADNI1, ADNI2, ADNI4, ADNI3, ADNIGO

  • RID numeric Participant roster ID

  • PTID character Participant ID

  • SUBJID character Subject ID used in NIAGADS for the whole genome sequencing data files generated by the AD Sequencing Project.

  • VISCODE character Visit code

  • VISCODE2 character Translated visit code

  • DRAWDATE Biomarker Draw Date Date: YYYY-MM-DD

  • PHC_Visit numeric Harmonized visit number Range value: 1, ..., 21

  • PHC_Age_Biomarker numeric Age at each biomarker visit Range value: 50.64, ..., 98.08

  • Tissue character Name of tissue extracted for biomarker measurement , with options: Plasma

  • Platform character Immunoassay platform used for biomarker measurement , with options: Fujirebio

  • AB40_RAW numeric Raw AB40 biomarker levels Range value: 188.78, ..., 492.01

  • PHC_AB40 numeric Harmonized Z-Score for AB40 biomarker levels Range value: -2.68821011257117, ..., 2.65305315296266

  • AB42_RAW numeric Raw AB42 biomarker levels Range value: 14.22, ..., 46.03

  • PHC_AB42 numeric Harmonized Z-Score for AB42 biomarker levels Range value: -2.90102651055181, ..., 2.81033524295847

  • Tau_RAW logical Raw Tau biomarker levels A Boolean value: TRUE/ FALSE

  • PHC_Tau logical Harmonized Z-Score for Tau biomarker levels A Boolean value: TRUE/ FALSE

  • pTau181_RAW logical Raw pTau181 biomarker levels A Boolean value: TRUE/ FALSE

  • PHC_pTau181 logical Harmonized Z-Score for pTau181 biomarker levels A Boolean value: TRUE/ FALSE

  • pTau217_RAW numeric Raw pTau217 biomarker levels Range value: 0.03, ..., 3.207

  • PHC_pTau217 numeric Harmonized Z-Score for pTau217 biomarker levels Range value: -2.12026575427977, ..., 2.99330563467903

  • update_stamp POSIXct: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS
